map.将 XML 映射为 JSON：标签为键、属性前缀化、重复标签转数组。便于前端用: Map XML to JSON: tags become keys, attributes are prefixed, and repeated tags become arrays—easy for front-end JS to consume directly. Conversion is local; nothing is uploaded.
map.旧接口 XML 接入前端: Feed legacy XML interfaces into the front end
map.配置 XML 转可读对象: Convert config XML into readable objects
map.属性默认加 @ 前缀避免与子节点冲突: Attributes get an @ prefix by default to avoid clashing with child nodes
map.无子节点无属性的标签直接变字符串: A tag with no children and no attributes becomes a plain string
map.同名多子节点自动成数组: Multiple same-name child nodes automatically become an array
map.通常加 \"@\" 前缀，如 <a id=\"1\"> → {\"a\":{\": Usually with an "@" prefix, e.g., <a id="1"> → {"a":{"@id":"1"}}.
